title: Launch signal orchestrator and release-note sync playline
creator: Marco Ruiz
description:
Purpose: Create a lightweight 'Launch Signal Orchestrator' playline that standardizes milestone traffic-light signals (GREEN / AMBER / RED), ties telemetry thresholds to cut decisions, and coordinates a single release-notes workflow across API, Console, and Runtime teams.

Why now: The upcoming integrated release spans three surface areas and multiple engineering teams. Past launches had inconsistent criteria and fragmented release notes that caused last-minute rollbacks and post-release hotfixes. This ticket defines the signal taxonomy, gating thresholds, comm schedule, and the owner map for release notes to reduce ambiguity and accelerate decision-making.

Scope:
- Define milestone signal model and telemetry thresholds for latency, error rate, model quality regressions, and cost-per-token regressions.
- Produce a daily pre-launch dashboard template and a release readiness checklist.
- Publish a single canonical release-notes doc + per-component changelog snippets and publishing schedule.
- Define canary rollouts and rollback triggers for hosted API, Dedicated, and Private (VPC) environments.

Out of scope: code-level runtime changes (ENG will own those separate tickets), detailed PRD for new console UI components (handled by DES/ENG sub-issues).

Deliverables:
1) Signal guide: definitions, thresholds, and examples (GREEN/AMBER/RED), with owner for each signal.
2) Readiness dashboard prototype (Grafana + Console dashboard kit).
3) Release-notes template and editorial owner rota.
4) Rollout runbook with canary percentages, timing, and rollback playbook.
5) Preflight checklist and comm cadence (stakeholder list + calendar invites).

Milestones (high level):
- 2025-02-07: Kickoff + initial signal taxonomy (owner alignment).
- 2025-02-14: Draft thresholds + telemetry queries for engineering.
- 2025-02-21: Dashboard prototype and release-notes skeleton.
- 2025-02-28: Dry run of preflight checklist; finalize comm calendar.
- 2025-03-07: Launch window (target release date).

Gating / Cut criteria (examples):
- Latency: p95 token generation latency for API baseline workload must be <= 350ms in hosted canary and <= 400ms in dedicated canary for 48h.
- Error rate: 5xx rate must be <= 0.3% on canary traffic for 24h.
- Regression detection: Quality regression as measured by production eval harness (seeded prompts) must be within 0.6% of control model in top-line metrics (or flagged for manual review).
- Cost: 24h rolling cost-per-1000-token must not exceed committed baseline by >15% without mitigation plan.
- Observability gaps: No known telemetry blindspots for critical flows (token-level tracing, KV-cache hit rates, model fallback rates).

Decision rules:
- All GREEN signals -> proceed from Canary -> Broad rollout.
- Any AMBER signal -> hold rollout, triage within 4 hours, execute mitigation playbook; proceed only if AMBER resolves to GREEN or an explicit PM+ENG exception is recorded.
- Any RED signal -> abort rollout and trigger rollback playbook.

Release-notes coordination:
- Single canonical doc lives in Drive: "Releases/2025-03-api-console-runtime/Release-Notes-canonical.md" (owner: Aisha Patel).
- Component owners (API, Console, Runtime) produce 1-paragraph changelog items by 2025-02-25.
- Eng lead attaches PR links and relevant migration notes. Docs/Developer Experience leads review for clarity.
- Marketing will be given the canonical doc 72h prior to launch for external comms.

Rollout plan (canary ladder):
- Phase 0 (Dry run): internal traffic, smoke tests (2h).
- Phase 1 (Canary A): 1% live traffic for 12 hours (monitor signals).
- Phase 2 (Canary B): 10% for 24 hours.
- Phase 3: 50% for 12 hours, then 100% if GREEN.

Stakeholders: PM (Aisha Patel), Eng leads (runtime: Claire Chen, api: Ravi Menon), Console owner (Sofia Lin), Design (Tom Yates), Observability (Priya Kapoor), Security (Ethan Brooks), Marketing (Lena Gomez), Support (Jordan Miller).
